svg.title: Figure 3-1: context and item boundary of the Gate A unit
svg.desc: The ten elements of the item in a grid inside a dashed boundary; the operator, the Wi-Fi network, bystanders and the mains on the left, each naming the interface IDs that cross the boundary to it; the site, the payload, the 2.0 upper body and the fleet server on the right; a red note that the E-stop button's wiring is undocumented.
